basic_info.description: Located in the peaceful Lakeshore District, this Mid-Century modern gem is fully detached and sits on a flat open lot. Renovated in 2009, this beautiful owner-occupied home boasts luxurious finishes with hardwood flooring, customized cherry wood cabinets, and customized blinds. The gourmet kitchen is a chef's dream, equipped with stainless steel Bosch and Thermador appliances, a heated built-in island, custom backsplash, and a skylight that fills the entire space with natural light. The primary suite includes a walk-through closet and a bathroom with a walk-in shower, sit-down bench, Toto toilet, and heated towel rack. The lower level offers a bonus room with a wet bar and full bathroom, along with a 2-car garage featuring Eufy security system and ample storage. The home is fully equipped with Honeywell smart home thermostat with alarm system, double-paned customized windows, electric fireplace with built-in TV and sound system, and updated HVAC. Enjoy the well-manicured artificial turf on the exterior front and backyards, ideal for low-maintenance outdoor living. This home offers the perfect blend of suburban tranquility and city convenience, with easy access to MUNI, the 280 Freeway, and local recreation at Lake Merced, Harding Park Golf Club, and Ocean Beach.
